message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Official)**  
*(Based on the official Uno® rulebook from Mattel)*  

---

### 1. Objective  
Be the first player to score **500 points**.  
Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round.

---

### 2. Components  
- 108 cards  
  - 25 × Red, 25 × Yellow, 25 × Green, 25 × Blue  
  - 4 × Wild, 4 × Wild Draw 4  
  - 2 × Draw 2, 2 × Skip, 2 × Reverse per color  

---

### 3. Setup  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Shuffle the deck and deal **7 cards** to each player. |
| 2 | Place the remaining deck face‑down as the **draw pile**. |
| 3 | Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the **discard pile**. |
| 4 | If the first card is a special card (Draw 2, Skip, Reverse, Wild, or Wild Draw 4), follow the special‑card rules below. |

---

### 4. Gameplay  

| Phase | What Happens |
|-------|--------------|
| **Turn** | Starting with the player to the left of the dealer, players take turns in clockwise order (unless a Reverse card changes direction). |
| **Play a Card** | On your turn, you may play **one** card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card. |
| **Draw a Card** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played immediately, you may do so; otherwise, your turn ends. |
| **Special Cards** | See section 5 for effects. |
| **Uno Call** | When you have only **one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty (see section 6). |
| **End of Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands. |

---

### 5. Special Cards  

| Card | Effect |
|------|--------|
| **Draw 2** | Next player draws two cards and loses their turn. |
| **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. |
| **Reverse** | Reverses the direction of play. In a two‑player game, it acts like a Skip. |
| **Wild** | Player chooses the new color to play. |
| **Wild Draw 4** | Player chooses the new color and the next player draws four cards and loses their turn. *Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards.* If challenged and found to have a playable card, the challenger draws six cards instead. |

---

### 6. Penalties  

| Situation | Penalty |
|-----------|---------|
| **UNO Not Called** | Player must draw two cards. |
| **Illegal Wild Draw 4 Play** | If a player challenges a Wild Draw 4 and the challenged player had a playable card, the challenger draws six cards. If the challenge is wrong, the challenger draws four cards. |
| **Illegal Play** | Player must draw one card. |

---

### 7. Scoring  

| Card | Points |
|------|--------|
| Number cards (0–9) | Face value |
| Draw 2, Skip, Reverse | 20 |
| Wild, Wild Draw 4 | 50 |

The winner of the round adds the total points of all other players’ cards to their score. The first player to reach **500 points** wins the game. (If playing a shorter game, you can set a lower target.)

---

### 8. Variations & House Rules  

- **Stacking**: Some groups allow stacking Draw 2 or Wild Draw 4 cards (e.g., a Draw 2 can be countered by another Draw 2). This is not part of the official rules.  
- **No Challenge**: Many players skip the challenge rule for Wild Draw 4 to keep the game faster.  
- **Custom Decks**: Uno can be played with a custom deck (e.g., Uno Horror, Uno Kids). Rules remain the same unless specified.

---

### 9. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet  

| Turn | Play | Draw | Skip | Reverse | Wild | Wild Draw 4 |
|------|------|------|------|---------|------|-------------|
| **Color Match** | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Number Match** | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Symbol Match** | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Wild** | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✔️ | ❌ |
| **Wild Draw 4** | ✔️ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✔️ | ✔️ |

---

**Enjoy your game!**  
Feel free to ask if you’d like deeper explanations on any rule or strategy tips.
